actions.description: Close or open the power-supply output (ALLOUTON/ALLOUTOFF)

inputs.description: True to close the output (ALLOUTON), False to open it (ALLOUTOFF)
inputs.name: enabled

actions.name: enable_output

outputs.description: The state sent to the supply; the profile has no output-state query
outputs.name: enabled

limit.reason: the profile notes give 0-64 V at the terminals in tracking-series mode; max_voltage_v on line 30 repeats the maximum
max_current_limit_a is 3.0 A; no line of the clone states a lower bound

device.name: GW Instek GPP-4323 DC power supply

facts.text: The GPP-4323 profile maps set_voltage to 'VSET1:{value:.4f}' and set_current_limit to 'ISET1:{value:.4f}'
The profile switches the output with ALLOUTON (on) and ALLOUTOFF (off)
The profile measures output voltage with VOUT1? and output current with IOUT1?
In tracking-series mode the terminals supply 0 to 64 V and only channel 1 is controlled
The profile notes confirm that VSET1? and ISET1? read back the value that was set
VOUT1? and IOUT1? append a unit suffix, and query_number extracts the first number
PowerSupply.set_voltage writes set_voltage and set_current_limit writes set_current_limit
PowerSupply.enable_output writes output_on_value or output_off_value according to its state
PowerSupply.measure_voltage and measure_current query the profile's measure commands
A serial profile with baud_rate 'auto' detects the speed from the *IDN? reply
The profile records the identity 'GW INSTEK,GPP-74323,SN:GEZ823770,V1.22'

measures.description: Output voltage measured by the supply (VOUT1?)
measures.name: voltage

measures.description: Output current measured by the supply (IOUT1?)
measures.name: current

safe_state.description: output disabled (ALLOUTOFF); the voltage and current setpoints keep their last applied values
